CLINICAL FEATURES OF BREAST CANCER
Clinical Features
- Breast: breast lump, bloody nipple discharge, breast or nipple ulceration
- Axilla: armpit swelling, upper limb lymphoedema
- Metastatic: respiratory (cough, breathlessness), liver (abdominal swelling,
jaundice), bones (bone pain, pathological fracture), brain (seizures), spine
(paraparesis or paraplegia), etc.
